findings.summary: __attrs_post_init__ pushes id_of(self.schema) unconditionally, so subschemas without $id push an empty/None scope that resets the resolver base and breaks relative $ref resolution; should push only when id is non-empty and not None.

Scopes pushed in __attrs_post_init__ are never popped (the only pop_scope at line 458 pairs with a different push), so a shared RefResolver accumulates stale scopes, growing memory and leaking scope into sibling subschema resolutions.
Three blank lines before the next top-level def trigger flake8 E303.
The new test only covers a top-level $id with $ref, so it would not catch the relative $ref bug in subschemas without $id.
